T3. Longterm development [NO] — no structural or long-horizon policy implications raised

Synopsis:
A federal judge ruled against SVB Financial Trust's $1.71B claim against the FDIC, finding that former SVB executives and directors acted negligently by taking excessive interest rate and liquidity risks — specifically over-concentrating in long-term Treasuries and MBS. The ruling closes one litigation front but leaves open a separate FDIC suit against 17 former executives including ex-CEO Gregory Becker. No regulatory or policy remedy is proposed; the ruling is purely a legal accountability finding.
